$comment: Catalog v9 (2026-07-31, per Bri) — 12 items, prices globally unique. Each item ONCE PER DAY per player (UI-enforced; same-day repeats are audited); rebuying on later days is allowed and restocks single-use items. The barrel (45) is the personal save; the curfew bell (35) is the village's night off — it beats everything, sharpened teeth included. Six-day deadline. Aimed items via p/aim; the barrel needs no aim — buying it is drinking it. The werebear may buy anything. Economy: 50 XLM buy-in, +25/day.

items.label: Horseshoe nail
items.effect: If today's vote ties on you, the nail steps you out of it. Whoever is left in the tie takes the rope — if more than one is left, nobody hangs. Single use.

items.label: Cold iron key
items.flavor: Fits more doors than it should.
items.effect: Pick a villager and a store. Tomorrow that store will not sell to them. Everyone is told which store was locked. Nobody is told who bought the key or who was locked out.

items.label: Curfew bell
items.flavor: DING DONG. MURDER HAS BEEN RESCHEDULED.
items.effect: Ring it, and the werebear stays home tonight. No hunting. No one dies tonight.

general_store.label: General Store
general_store.subtitle: Everything you need. Nothing you can explain.

items.label: Shopkeeper's holiday
items.flavor: Everyone deserves a rest. Tomorrow, ideally.
items.effect: Pick a store. Tomorrow it is closed to everyone. Announced publicly.

items.label: Sock in mouth
items.flavor: Clean, mostly. That is not the point.
items.effect: Pick a villager. They can still type in the chat, but their vote will not count today. If they try to cast it, the morning report names them.

items.label: Barrel of beer
items.flavor: Finish it and the night finishes you.
items.effect: You cannot vote today, and you cannot be killed tonight — nothing gets through, including the tooth sharpener. No effect if you are the werebear.

items.label: Soup bone
items.flavor: Somebody else's dog will love you for it.
items.effect: Pick another villager. If the werebear targets you tonight, there is a 1 in 4 chance it targets them instead.

items.label: The butcher's knife
items.effect: Your vote counts twice at today's trial. If somebody hangs, the village is told a double vote was cast; nobody is ever told whose.

items.label: Tooth sharpener
items.flavor: Ask no questions about the previous owner.
items.effect: Werebear: tonight's kill goes through — soup bones and offerings do not stop it. Only the barrel of beer does. Villager: if the werebear targets you tonight, a 50/50 chance it takes this instead and leaves you alone.

items.label: Gerald's finger
items.flavor: The Mayor swears it is his. The Mayor swears a lot.

items.label: Unquiet rest
items.flavor: The Mayor accepts coin for almost anything.
items.effect: When you die, a 50/50 chance your ghost can still vote. The result is announced either way.

items.label: The long candle
items.flavor: Burns all night. Sees about half of it.
items.effect: Pick a villager. A 50/50 chance you privately learn, on the spot, whether they are the werebear; otherwise you learn nothing. It never lies.
